steps.text: Extract and add contents of an egg to a microwave-safe bowl
Microwave for 3 minutes, stirring in between
Add 1/2 tbsp sweet and sour sauce to the bowl
Add 1 tbsp salsa to the bowl
Place 8 inch tortilla on a cutting board
Mix the contents of the bowl well
Pour egg mixture on top of the tortilla
Sprinkle 1 tbsp shredded cheddar cheese on top of the egg
Roll the tortilla from one end to another into a log shape, about 1.5 inches thick. Roll it tight enough to prevent gaps but not so tight that the filling leaks
